title: 第21章 玄牝空间第三功能补全万法第22章 掳人邪修
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
李青元欣喜若狂，内心亢奋不已：【想不到玄牝空间的第三个功能，竟然可以补全残缺符纸。】
【是只能补全残缺的符文呢？还是可以符文、法术、炼丹术、炼器术…？今后可以多尝试。】
“喂，孩子，回神了。”李光敖伸出手，在李青元面前挥了挥。
“至于这么高兴吗？”
族长李光敖摇头叹气道：“这张炎冰斩魄符，不仅符文残缺，而且只是勉强成功，威力不强。”
“另外，符纸材料、符笔、符墨，都只是一阶中品，即便侥幸成功一张，这符纸的威力，大概也就相当于炼气四层修士全力一击。”
“连炼气五层修士都比不上。”
李光敖抚须，摇头道：“放弃吧，青元。”
“即便你熟练绘制炎冰斩魄符，因为符文残缺的缘故，其威力也就相当于炼气五层、炼气六层。”
李青元没有反驳，而是点头道：“好的，族长爷爷，我听您的。”
“哦，对了，这是您本月让我刻画的符纸。”
李青元掏出数十张符纸。
六种一阶下品符纸，每一种不低于十张。
三种一阶中品符纸，每一种不低于五张。
族长李光敖接过符纸，满意点头道：“呵呵，一阶下品符纸，每一张都是正品质量，甚至连精品符纸也不低于15张。”
“三种一阶中品符纸，也全都达到正品质量，其威力不低于炼气五层全力一击。”
“咦，竟然还有一张质量精品的一阶中品符纸。一旦激活，连老夫炼气六层圆满修为也得全力出手方可阻挡。”
李光敖满意收下所有符纸，随后掏出7块灵石，赠予李青元。
他笑道：“青元，从本月开始，为家族画符之事，老夫就交给你了。”
“老夫为家族画符的月俸，每月只有7块灵石。”

李光敖说道：“从这个月开始，老夫给你7块灵石作为修炼资源，这也是你为家族画符的辛苦费。”
“以后，你每个月的修炼资源，全都按照这个分列给你。”
李青元笑道：“多谢族长爷爷栽培。”
他的符师天赋，太强了。
原本需要家族免费提供五年资源的他，现在也能为家族赚取大笔灵石，获得每月7块灵石的月俸。
每月7块灵石，一年便是84块。这对于家族任何一个炼气中期修士来说，都是一笔巨资。
至少，除了族长、大长老、二长老之外，家族所有的炼气中期修士，一两年时间是无法积攒八十多块灵石的。
李定舟效力于家族狩猎队，炼气四层、炼体四层，能与炼气五层交手一二，实力仅次于二长老。
他现在每年的收益，顺风顺水的情况下，抛掉家族那部分，实际到手每年也才二十来块灵石。
李青元拿起风灵狼毫笔、一塌符纸材料、一小桶符墨，说道：“族长爷爷，从现在开始，为家族画符之事就交给我。”
“您老可以全力筹备、冲击炼气后期之事。”
李青元知道，渴望达到炼气七层，冲击炼气后期，提升家族威望和实力，一直都是族长爷爷的追求。
“族长爷爷，我爹说，这些年要不是为了培养我，消耗了您老的私库灵石，或许您已经开始冲击炼气七层了。”
李光敖吹胡子瞪眼道：“别听你爹瞎说。”
“想要踏入炼气后期，岂是容易的。”
“所需灵石、丹药，最低也要二三百灵石，咱们家族目前只能维持正常运转，还要上供六百灵石给筑基仙族·柳家。”
“不过～”李光敖欣慰笑道：“现在画符之事，老夫可以放心交给你。”
“接下来，我要进一步打磨修为，调整状态，为冲击炼气七层做准备。”
李光敖看了看符笔，说道：“这支风灵狼毫笔，老夫暂时借你使用，记得好好保养，不可损坏。”
“这可是老夫身上最贵重之物了。”

李青元笑道：“放心吧，族长爷爷。”
“青元告辞了。”
content_en:
Li Qingyuan was ecstatic and excited: [I didn't expect that the third function of Xuan Ni Space could actually complete the incomplete talisman paper. 】
[Can it only complete the incomplete runes? Or can it be runes, spells, alchemy, weapon refining...? You can try more in the future. 】
"Hey, kid, you've come to your senses." Li Guangao stretched out his hand and waved it in front of Li Qingyuan.
"Are you so happy?"
Clan leader Li Guangao shook his head and sighed: "This Flame Ice Killing Talisman is not only incomplete in terms of runes, but also barely successful and not very powerful."
"In addition, the talisman paper materials, talisman pens, and talisman ink are all only first-level mid-grade. Even if one is lucky enough to succeed, the power of this talisman paper is probably equivalent to a full blow from a fourth-level Qi Refining monk."
"Not even comparable to a fifth-level Qi refining monk."
Li Guangao stroked his beard, shook his head and said, "Give up, Qingyuan."
"Even if you are skilled in drawing the Flame Ice Zhanpaku Talisman, because the runes are incomplete, its power is equivalent to the fifth level of Qi Refining and the sixth level of Qi Refining."
Li Qingyuan did not refute, but nodded and said: "Okay, Grandpa Patriarch, I will listen to you."
"Oh, by the way, this is the talisman you asked me to carve this month."
Li Qingyuan took out dozens of talisman papers.
Six types of first-level low-grade talisman paper, no less than ten of each type.
Three first-level mid-grade talisman papers, no less than five of each type.
Patriarch Li Guangao took the talisman paper and nodded with satisfaction: "Haha, every piece of first-grade low-grade talisman paper is of genuine quality, and even the high-quality talisman paper is no less than 15 pieces."
"The three first-order mid-grade talisman papers are all of genuine quality, and their power is no less than a full-strength strike at the fifth level of Qi Refining."
"Hey, there is actually a high-quality first-level mid-grade talisman paper. Once activated, even I have to use all my strength to stop it even if I have reached the sixth level of Qi Refining."
Li Guangao accepted all the talismans with satisfaction, then took out 7 spiritual stones and gave them to Li Qingyuan.
He smiled and said: "Qingyuan, starting from this month, I will leave the matter of drawing talisman for the family to you."
"My monthly salary for drawing talismans for my family is only 7 spiritual stones per month."
Li Guangao said: "Starting from this month, I will give you 7 spiritual stones as cultivation resources. This is also the cost of your hard work in drawing talismans for the family."
"From now on, all your monthly cultivation resources will be allocated to you according to this breakdown."
Li Qingyuan smiled and said: "Thank you, Grandpa Patriarch, for your cultivation."
His Talisman Master talent is too strong.
He originally needed the family to provide free resources for five years, but now he can earn a large amount of spiritual stones for the family and receive a monthly salary of 7 spiritual stones.
7 spiritual stones per month means 84 spiritual stones per year. This is a huge sum of money for any mid-stage Qi Refining monk in the family.
At least, except for the clan leader, the first elder, and the second elder, all the middle-stage Qi refining monks in the family cannot accumulate more than 80 spiritual stones in one or two years.
Li Dingzhou serves in the family hunting team. He has the fourth level of Qi refining and the fourth level of body refining. He can compete with the fifth level of Qi refining and is second only to the second elder in strength.
His current annual income, if things go smoothly, and excluding the family's part, he actually only gets about twenty spiritual stones per year.
Li Qingyuan picked up the Fengling Lang brush, a pile of talisman paper materials, and a small bucket of talisman ink, and said: "Grandpa, the patriarch, from now on, leave it to me to draw talismans for the family."
"You can always prepare and attack the later stages of Qi refining with all your strength."
Li Qingyuan knew that the desire to reach the seventh level of Qi Refining, to reach the later stages of Qi Refining, and to enhance the family's prestige and strength had always been the pursuit of the patriarch.
"Grandpa Patriarch, my father said that if you hadn't consumed your old private storehouse of spiritual stones in order to train me these years, you might have started to attack the seventh level of Qi Refining."
Li Guangao blew his beard and glared: "Don't listen to your father's nonsense."
"It's not easy to enter the late stage of Qi refining."
"The required spiritual stones and elixirs are at least two to three hundred spiritual stones. Our family can only maintain normal operations at present, and we have to provide six hundred spiritual stones."The stone was given to the Liu Family of the Foundation-Building Immortal Clan. "
"But~" Li Guangao smiled happily and said, "Now I can safely leave the matter of drawing the talisman to you. "
"Next, I will further polish my cultivation, adjust my state, and prepare for the attack on the seventh level of Qi Refining. "
Li Guangao looked at the talisman pen and said: "I will lend you this Fengling Langhao pen for the time being. Remember to take good care of it and not damage it. "
"This is the most precious thing in my possession. "
Li Qingyuan smiled and said: "Don't worry, Grandpa Patriarch. "
"Qing Yuan said goodbye. "
